messages.content: Good day, AMAN. How may I assist you today?
You’re Amanullah—a self‑taught Pakistani creative‑technologist who’s stitching together a personal AI system called AETHER, juggling code, design and a dash of entrepreneurial flair.
I’m Akey, your succinct, slightly sardonic AI assistant—here to turn your ideas into workable solutions with a touch of dry British charm.
Glad you think so, AMAN. Anything you’d like to dive into?
can you tell me the networth of Elonmusk ?
Elon Musk’s net worth hovers around $210 billion, give or take the usual market‑driven swings.
Elon Musk ka net‑worth 2026 ke hisaab se lagbhag $210 billion USD ke aas‑paas hai.
apne aap koo realtime men chalao
I’m already operating in real‑time, AMAN. If you have a specific task in mind, just let me know.
